<!--
  The Price of an IKEA KLIPPAN
  One two-seat sofa in 26 European countries, drawn as a receipt.

  Structure
    1. Setup   - load data, prepare HTML snippets
    2. Layout  - SVG filter, CSS, page container
    3. Receipt - one bar per country
    4. Closing - summary, signature, page footer

  The page <div> opened in section 2 is closed at the very end of the file.
  Chunks only contain self-contained HTML strings, so Pandoc cannot break them.
-->

<!-- ===== 1. Setup ===== -->

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

# Country lookup: ISO code, display name, flag emoji
countries <- tribble(
  ~country, ~country_name,             ~flag,
  "at",     "Austria",         "🇦🇹",
  "be",     "Belgium",         "🇧🇪",
  "ch",     "Switzerland",     "🇨🇭",
  "cz",     "Czech Republic",  "🇨🇿",
  "de",     "Germany",         "🇩🇪",
  "dk",     "Denmark",         "🇩🇰",
  "ee",     "Estonia",         "🇪🇪",
  "es",     "Spain",           "🇪🇸",
  "fi",     "Finland",         "🇫🇮",
  "fr",     "France",          "🇫🇷",
  "gb",     "Great Britain",   "🇬🇧",
  "hr",     "Croatia",         "🇭🇷",
  "hu",     "Hungary",         "🇭🇺",
  "ie",     "Ireland",         "🇮🇪",
  "it",     "Italy",           "🇮🇹",
  "lt",     "Lithuania",       "🇱🇹",
  "lv",     "Latvia",          "🇱🇻",
  "nl",     "Netherlands",     "🇳🇱",
  "no",     "Norway",          "🇳🇴",
  "pl",     "Poland",          "🇵🇱",
  "pt",     "Portugal",        "🇵🇹",
  "ro",     "Romania",         "🇷🇴",
  "rs",     "Serbia",          "🇷🇸",
  "se",     "Sweden",          "🇸🇪",
  "si",     "Slovenia",        "🇸🇮",
  "sk",     "Slovakia",        "🇸🇰"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Load and prepare data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
ikea <- read_csv("../data/ikea_seating.csv")

product_no <- 40399314   # KLIPPAN 2-seat sofa

klippan <- ikea |>
  filter(item_no == product_no, country %in% countries$country) |>
  left_join(countries, by = "country") |>
  transmute(country_name, flag, price_usd, price = round(price_usd)) |>
  arrange(desc(price_usd)) |>                      # most expensive first
  mutate(
    width_pct = price / max(price) * 100,
    row_class = case_when(
      row_number() == 1 ~ " is-top",               # most expensive country
      row_number() == n() ~ " is-low",             # cheapest country
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    note = if_else(row_class == " is-low",
                   '<span class="low-note">cheapest</span>', "")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# HTML snippets
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
lines_html <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    '<div class="receipt-line%s">',
    '<span class="country">%s</span>',
    '<span class="flag">%s</span>',
    '<span class="price">$%d</span>',
    '<div class="bar-track"><div class="bar" style="--width: %.1f%%;"></div></div>',
    '%s</div>'
  ),
  klippan$row_class, klippan$country_name, klippan$flag,
  as.integer(klippan$price), klippan$width_pct, klippan$note
) |>
  paste(collapse = "\n")

# Summary statistics for the receipt footer
summary_html <- paste0(
  '<div class="receipt-summary">',
  '<div class="summary-row"><span class="summary-label">TOTAL COUNT:</span><span>',
  nrow(klippan), ' Countries</span></div>',
  '<div class="summary-row"><span class="summary-label">PRICE RANGE:</span><span>$',
  sprintf("%.2f", min(klippan$price_usd)), ' – $',
  sprintf("%.2f", max(klippan$price_usd)), '</span></div>',
  '<div class="summary-row"><span class="summary-label">MEDIAN:</span><span>$',
  sprintf("%.2f", median(klippan$price_usd)), '</span></div>',
  '</div>'
)
```

<!-- ===== 2. Layout ===== -->

```{=html}
<!-- SVG filter for the irregular (burnt) top edge of the paper -->
<svg style="display:none;">
  <filter id="burnt-edge">
    <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.04" numOctaves="5" result="noise" />
    <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="noise" scale="12" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G" />
  </filter>
</svg>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IM+Fell+English:ital@0;1&family=Caveat:wght@500;600&display=swap');

/* ---------- Page ---------- */
#title-block-header { display: none; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  background-color: #e8e4d9;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

/* ---------- Paper container ---------- */
.paper-container {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 740px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 1100px;
  padding: 50px 0 50px 60px;
  margin: 0 auto 60px auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  box-shadow: 25px 35px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  background-color: #e8e4d9;
  background-image: url("../images/logo1.png");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
  print-color-adjust: exact;
}

/* Inner sheet */
.paper-container::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 15px;
  background-color: #faf9f6;
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Burnt top edge */
.paper-container::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  height: 24px;
  background-color: #faf9f6;
  filter: url(#burnt-edge);
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Keep content above the inner sheet */
.masthead, .masthead-rule, .body-from-rule,
.page-attribution, .footer-spacer, .page-footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
}

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
.masthead {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 19px;
  letter-spacing: 7px;
  color: #2f6f4f;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.masthead-rule {
  width: 93%;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 2px solid #2f6f4f;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}

/* ---------- Body ---------- */
.body-from-rule {
  margin-left: -35px;
  padding-left: 32px;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* Vertical green rule */
.body-from-rule::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -3px;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background-color: #2f6f4f;
}

.text-content {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.title {
  font-size: 35px;
  line-height: 1.12;
  color: #3F3C37;
  margin: 0 0 18px 0;
}

.section-bar {
  background: #e2eae4;
  color: #2f6f4f;
  font-size: 30px;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 1.2;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 8px 14px 9px;
  margin: 0 0 58px 0;
  max-width: 93%;
}

/* ---------- Receipt ---------- */
.receipt-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 540px;
  margin: 0 auto 30px auto;
  padding: 25px 20px 30px 20px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background-color: #fffef0;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

/* Perforated top edge */
.receipt-container::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    #e8e4d9, #e8e4d9 5px,
    transparent 5px, transparent 10px
  );
}

.receipt-header {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  color: #3F3C37;
}

.receipt-barcode {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.receipt-barcode img {
  width: 220px;
  height: auto;
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;   /* white image background blends into the cream receipt */
}

.receipt-logo {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 10px 0 8px 0;
}

.receipt-logo img {
  width: 140px;
  height: auto;
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}

.receipt-product  { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 5px; }
.receipt-item-no  { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 15px; }

.receipt-dashed-line {
  border-top: 2px dashed #3F3C37;
  margin: 15px 0;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* Handwritten annotation on the receipt */
.title-note {
  position: absolute;
  top: 95px;
  left: 400px;
  width: 130px;
  font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 21px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: #a8503f;
  text-align: center;
  transform: rotate(-6deg);
  z-index: 10;
}

/* ---------- Receipt lines ---------- */
.receipt-lines {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 16px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

.receipt-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.country {
  flex: 0 0 180px;      /* fixed width so all bars start at the same x */
  text-align: left;
}

.price {
  position: relative;   /* anchor for the highlight circle */
  flex: 0 0 36px;
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.bar-track {
  flex: 1;              /* the rest of the row belongs to the bar */
  min-width: 0;
}

.bar {
  height: 8px;
  width: var(--width);
  background-color: #2f6f4f;
}

/* ---------- Highlighted rows (most expensive / cheapest) ---------- */
.receipt-line.is-top,
.receipt-line.is-low {
  position: relative;
  margin-left: -8px;
  margin-right: -8px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
}

.receipt-line.is-top {
  --accent: #a8503f;
  background: rgba(168, 80, 63, 0.18);
}

.receipt-line.is-low {
  --accent: #2f6f4f;
  background: rgba(47, 111, 79, 0.18);
}

/* Hand-drawn circle around the price */
.is-top .price::after,
.is-low .price::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -7px -9px;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-4deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.low-note {
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px;
  font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 21px;
  color: var(--accent);
  transform: rotate(-3deg);
}

/* ---------- Receipt summary ---------- */
.receipt-summary {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  color: #3F3C37;
}

.summary-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.summary-label { font-weight: bold; }

.receipt-signature {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 25px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #3F3C37;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.receipt-signature .subtitle {
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* ---------- Page footer ---------- */
.page-attribution {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #2f6f4f;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.page-attribution span + span { margin-left: 140px; }

.footer-spacer { height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.page-footer {
  width: 93%;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 12px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: #4a4640;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  border-top: 1px solid #dcd8d0;
}

/* ---------- Print (A4) ---------- */
@media print {
  @page { size: A4; margin: 0; }
  body { width: 210mm; height: 297mm; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
  .paper-container {
    width: 210mm !important; height: 297mm !important;
    max-width: none !important; min-height: auto !important;
    margin: 0 !important; padding: 15mm !important; box-shadow: none !important;
    background-image: url("../images/logo1.png") !important;
    background-size: 100% 100% !important;
    background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important; print-color-adjust: exact !important;
  }
  .paper-container::before {
    inset: 0 !important; top: 15mm !important; left: 15mm !important;
    right: 15mm !important; bottom: 15mm !important;
    background-color: #faf9f6 !important; box-shadow: none !important;
  }
  .paper-container::after {
    top: 14mm !important; left: 14mm !important; right: 14mm !important; height: 8mm !important;
  }
}
</style>

          <div class="receipt-dashed-line"></div>

        <div class="receipt-lines">
```
